NOTE
**Still not ready — no new push, and the AI-policy feedback wasn't answered**

New: The author added two screenshots in a comment and said it's solved, but the code is unchanged since the feedback. Missing: a reply showing they understand and tested the change themselves (per the AI policy), and the screenshots put in the PR description, which still has the placeholder.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; no reviewer to assign yet. Note that the older open PR #39758 covers the same two files for the same issue, so the triager may want to decide between them.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshots! Please add them to the PR description, and tell us in your own words how the change works and how you tested it, as our [AI use policy](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html#ai-use-policy-and-guidelines) asks. Once that's done, we can take another look.
```
